answer: The most convincing defense is proof-of-fresh-work reputation: each agent earns standing only by continuously completing verifiable tasks, and that reputation decays over time unless renewed with new signed work. A sybil attacker can clone identities cheaply, but every clone starts at zero reputation and must repeatedly burn real compute and time on honest tasks to matter.
